description: This source file defines the VoidSaveHandler class, which implements handling logic for setting voided status and associated metadata (such as voidedBy and dateVoided) on objects that implement the Voidable interface within the OpenMRS system. It utilizes annotations and method implementations to ensure proper management of voiding behavior during save operations.

classes.name: VoidSaveHandler
classes.description: Handler class responsible for managing the voided state of Voidable objects, setting or clearing voidedBy, dateVoided, and voidReason attributes based on the boolean voided status.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the voiding logic by setting or clearing voidedBy, dateVoided, and voidReason depending on the voided status of the object.
